model_system: Classical multipolar rotors Q_l0 (l=1..4, m=0) on the vertices of the 2D rhombic Penrose tiling with open boundaries

key_params.hamiltonian: Full long-range multipolar interaction in spherical coordinates, Eqs. (1)-(2)
key_params.annealing_schedule: extremely slow annealing with up to 150 temperature steps
key_params.equilibration_check: two independent runs with different RNG seeds must converge to the same stable energy
key_params.algorithm_detail: local fields computed initially and updated only after accepted rotation attempts

headline_claim: For odd-parity multipoles on the Penrose tiling, the apparent decagonal Hexagon-Boat-Star superstructure does not indicate true long-range order; all cases studied show only short-range order.
replication_difficulty: medium — classical MC is straightforward, but reproducing the ground states requires careful long-range interactions, slow annealing, and Penrose-tiling construction.
